china.firstPassageConvention: event must first be fully observable no later than month 24; pre-horizon history needed to satisfy eight-quarter nominal-growth run is not available in this module
china.logic: (C1 AND C2 AND C3) AND (C4 OR C5)

definition.firstPassageConvention: both component events must first be fully observed by month 24; China’s eight-quarter nominal-growth criterion needs pre-horizon history, not supplied in this lane
definition.jointDescription: US: AI-leader basket drawdown at or below 50% within 24 months with liquidity vacuum and systemic financial stress. China: nominal growth at or below 1% for at least 8 quarters, deflation for at least 4 quarters, property prices down at least 25%, and LGFV or trust restructurings or bank recapitalisation.

dependence.type: common liquidity factor / bounded structural calibration
dependence.estimationNote: US tail probability is statistical; China conditional crisis transmission is a structural calibration spanning historical stress analogues. Dependence is not point-identified.

earlyWarningDashboard.variable: St. Louis Fed Financial Stress Index

frontierSurface.interpretation: conditional tipping surface, not necessary or causal conditions

method.commonDrawContract: contagion.draw_contract.DrawBundle and PathState; no module-local RNG; assert identical draw IDs/order/dates before row-wise joint conjunction
method.conditionalTippingMethod: paired simultaneous conditional simulation across the two-driver frontier; thresholds null/not_reached outside plausible support; no extrapolation
method.estimator: same-draw Monte Carlo frequency; no independent joint sampler
method.intervalCoverage: Parameter and dependence-model uncertainty are not available in this lane; Wilson interval from Bernoulli frequency alone would cover only finite-draw uncertainty.
limitations: US severe-crisis likelihood remains unavailable while monthly systemic-stress inputs and endogenous FS path rule are incomplete (review amendment 9).
China hidden-debt perimeter and monthly crisis paths are not sourced in this lane (review amendment 17).
Dependence alternatives cannot be calibrated from the small set of stress episodes; tail dependence is not identified (review amendment 11).
Univariate boundaries are conditional tipping levels, not necessary conditions (review amendment 13).
